11477: function parseStudentLine(line) {
11478:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
11479:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
11480:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
11481:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
11482:     : trimmed.includes(",")
11483:       ? trimmed.split(/,+/)
11484:       : trimmed.split(/\s+/);
11485:   return { number: (parts.shift() || "").trim(), name: parts.join(" ").trim() };
11486: }

11477: function parseStudentLine(line) {
11478:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
11479:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
11480:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
11481:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
11482:     : trimmed.includes(",")
11483:       ? trimmed.split(/,+/)
11484:       : trimmed.split(/\s+/);
11485:   return { number: (parts.shift() || "").trim(), name: parts.join(" ").trim() };
11486: }

402: async function withStartupTimeout(promise, milliseconds, fallback = null) {
403:   let timer;
404:   try {
405:     return await Promise.race([
406:       Promise.resolve(promise),
407:       new Promise((resolve) => { timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(fallback), milliseconds); }),
408:     ]);
409:   } finally {
410:     if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
411:   }

640: function updateTopSyncStatus() {

649:     return;

651:   if (readonlyCache?.students?.length && neisData?.ok && !neisData.offline) {

660:     button.title = neisError || "UEP 구글시트는 연결되었고 NEIS 자료를 확인 중입니다.";
661:     return;
662:   }

664:     button.classList.add("bad");

1604: function defaultNightStudyRules(){
1605:   return [
1606:     {id:'weekly-wed',name:'수요일 미운영',type:'weekday',weekday:3,active:true},
1607:     {id:'summer-2026',name:'2026 여름방학 미운영',type:'range',start:'2026-08-08',end:'2026-08-17',active:true}

1610: function readNightStudyRules(){
1611:   try{const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(NIGHT_STUDY_RULES_STORE)||'null');return Array.isArray(saved)?saved:defaultNightStudyRules();}
1612:   catch{return defaultNightStudyRules();}
1613: }
1614: function nightStudyOperationStatus(key){
1615:   const date=new Date(`${key}T12:00:00`);
1616:   const rules=readNightStudyRules().filter(r=>r&&r.active!==false);
1617:   for(const r of rules){
1618:     if(r.type==='range'&&r.start&&r.end&&key>=r.start&&key<=r.end)return {operates:false,reason:r.name||'미운영 기간'};
1619:     if(r.type==='weekday'&&Number(r.weekday)===date.getDay())return {operates:false,reason:r.name||'요일 미운영'};
1620:   }
1621:   return {operates:true,reason:'운영일'};
1622: }

1884: function dormTermRoster(mode){
1885:   const term=dormTermDefinition(mode);if(!term)return [];
1886:   const all=[...(readonlyCache?.dormHistory||[]),...(readonlyCache?.pastDormStudents||[]),...(readonlyCache?.dormStudents||[])];
1887:   const seen=new Set();
1888:   return all.filter(row=>{
1889:     const year=String(row.year||'').replace(/\.0$/,'');
1890:     const sem=String(row.semester||'').replace(/[^0-9]/g,'');
1891:     const no=String(row.studentNo||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
1892:     const inferredGrade=no?Number(no[0]):Number(String(row.className||'').match(/^([123])[- ]/)?.[1]||1);
1893:     const grade=Number(row.grade||inferredGrade||1);
1894:     if(year&&term.year&&year!==term.year)return false;
1895:     if(grade!==term.grade)return false;
1896:     if(term.semester&&sem&&sem!==term.semester)return false;
1897:     if(term.semester&&!sem){
1898:       const start=String(row.startDate||'');
1899:       if(start){const month=Number(start.slice(5,7));if(term.semester==='1'&&month>=8)return false;if(term.semester==='2'&&month>0&&month<7)return false;}
1900:     }
1901:     const key=`${row.studentId||row.studentNo}|${term.label}`;if(seen.has(key))return false;seen.add(key);return true;
1902:   }).sort(dormStudentNoSort);
1903: }

2487: function uepComparableDate(value,basis=attendanceViewDate||dateKey(today)){
2488:   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
2489:   if(typeof value==='object')value=value.formattedValue||value.value||value.date||value.serial||'';
2490:   const text=String(value).trim();
2491:   // __UEP_08160_ISO_CALENDAR_DATE__
2492:   if(/^20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}T.*(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})$/i.test(text)){
2493:     const instant=new Date(text);
2494:     if(!Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())){
2495:       const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(instant);
2496:       const p=Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));
2497:       if(p.year&&p.month&&p.day)return p.year+'-'+p.month+'-'+p.day;
2498:     }
2499:   }
2500:   if(/^\d{5}(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(text)){
2501:     const serial=Number(text),utc=new Date(Math.round((serial-25569)*86400000));
2502:     if(!Number.isNaN(utc.getTime()))return `${utc.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(utc.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(utc.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
2503:   }
2504:   const full=text.match(/(20\d{2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})/);
2505:   if(full)return `${full[1]}-${full[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${full[3].padStart(2,'0')}`;
2506:   const compact=text.replace(/\D/g,'');
2507:   if(/^20\d{6}$/.test(compact))return compact.slice(0,4)+'-'+compact.slice(4,6)+'-'+compact.slice(6,8);
2508:   const monthDay=text.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})\s*(?:월|[.\-/])\s*(\d{1,2})(?:\s*일)?(?:\D|$)/);
2509:   if(monthDay){const year=String(basis||dateKey(today)).slice(0,4)||'2026';return year+'-'+monthDay[1].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+monthDay[2].padStart(2,'0');}
2510:   const parsed=new Date(text);
2511:   if(!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()))return `${parsed.getFullYear()}-${String(parsed.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(parsed.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
2512:   return text.slice(0,10);
2513: }

3521:     );
3522:     const studentSubjects=subjects.filter(row=>
3523:       String(row.studentId||"")===String(student.id||"")

3529:     if(outputCenterState.errorFilter==="normal")return row.errors.length===0;
3530:     return true;
3531:   });

4163: function subjectConfidentialPasswordHash(){return String(localStorage.getItem(UEP_SUBJECT_CONFIDENTIAL_PIN_KEY)||'');}
4164: function subjectConfidentialPasswordConfigured(){return !!subjectConfidentialPasswordHash();}
4165: async function subjectConfidentialDigest(value){const bytes=new TextEncoder().encode(String(value||''));const hash=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',bytes);return [...new Uint8Array(hash)].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');}

4270: function scorePeriodKey(row) {
4271:   const year = String(row?.schoolYear || today.getFullYear()).replace(/[^0-9]/g, "") || String(today.getFullYear());
4272:   let semester = String(row?.semester || "").match(/[12]/)?.[0] || "";
4273:   if (!semester && row?.scoreType === "모의고사") {
4274:     const month = Number(String(row.exam || "").match(/(\d{1,2})\s*월/)?.[1] || 0);
4275:     semester = month && month >= 8 ? "2" : "1";
4276:   }
4277:   return `${year}-${semester || "1"}`;
4278: }

4273:   if (!semester && row?.scoreType === "모의고사") {
4274:     const month = Number(String(row.exam || "").match(/(\d{1,2})\s*월/)?.[1] || 0);
4275:     semester = month && month >= 8 ? "2" : "1";
4276:   }
4277:   return `${year}-${semester || "1"}`;
4278: }

4276:   }

4278: }

4270: function scorePeriodKey(row) {
4271:   const year = String(row?.schoolYear || today.getFullYear()).replace(/[^0-9]/g, "") || String(today.getFullYear());
4272:   let semester = String(row?.semester || "").match(/[12]/)?.[0] || "";
4273:   if (!semester && row?.scoreType === "모의고사") {
4274:     const month = Number(String(row.exam || "").match(/(\d{1,2})\s*월/)?.[1] || 0);
4275:     semester = month && month >= 8 ? "2" : "1";
4276:   }
4277:   return `${year}-${semester || "1"}`;
4278: }
4279: function scorePeriodLabel(key) {
4280:   if (!key || key === "all") return "전체 누적";
4281:   const [year, semester] = String(key).split("-");
4282:   return `${year}학년도 ${semester || "1"}학기`;
4283: }

4288: function scoreExamOrder(exam) {
4289:   const order = ["1차고사","2차고사","학기말고사","3월모의고사","6월모의고사","9월모의고사","10월모의고사","11월모의고사","수능"];
4290:   const index = order.indexOf(exam);
4291:   return index < 0 ? 999 : index;
4292: }
4293: function scoreTrend(row, allRows) {
4294:   const orders = row.scoreType === "모의고사" ? ["3월모의고사","6월모의고사","9월모의고사","10월모의고사","11월모의고사"] : ["1차고사","2차고사","학기말고사"];
4295:   const index = orders.indexOf(row.exam);
4296:   if (index <= 0 || row.level === "" || row.level == null) return { text:"-", cls:"" };
4297:   const period = scorePeriodKey(row);
4298:   const previous = allRows.find(x => x.studentId === row.studentId && x.scoreType === row.scoreType && x.subject === row.subject && x.exam === orders[index - 1] && scorePeriodKey(x) === period);
4299:   if (!previous || previous.level === "" || previous.level == null) return { text:"-", cls:"" };
4300:   const diff = Number(previous.level) - Number(row.level);
4301:   if (!Number.isFinite(diff) || diff === 0) return { text:"유지", cls:"" };
4302:   return diff > 0 ? { text:`▲ ${Math.abs(diff)}등급`, cls:"good" } : { text:`▼ ${Math.abs(diff)}등급`, cls:"bad" };
4303: }

4270: function scorePeriodKey(row) {
4271:   const year = String(row?.schoolYear || today.getFullYear()).replace(/[^0-9]/g, "") || String(today.getFullYear());
4272:   let semester = String(row?.semester || "").match(/[12]/)?.[0] || "";
4273:   if (!semester && row?.scoreType === "모의고사") {
4274:     const month = Number(String(row.exam || "").match(/(\d{1,2})\s*월/)?.[1] || 0);
4275:     semester = month && month >= 8 ? "2" : "1";
4276:   }
4277:   return `${year}-${semester || "1"}`;
4278: }
4279: function scorePeriodLabel(key) {
4280:   if (!key || key === "all") return "전체 누적";
4281:   const [year, semester] = String(key).split("-");
4282:   return `${year}학년도 ${semester || "1"}학기`;
4283: }

4289:   const order = ["1차고사","2차고사","학기말고사","3월모의고사","6월모의고사","9월모의고사","10월모의고사","11월모의고사","수능"];

4293: function scoreTrend(row, allRows) {
4294:   const orders = row.scoreType === "모의고사" ? ["3월모의고사","6월모의고사","9월모의고사","10월모의고사","11월모의고사"] : ["1차고사","2차고사","학기말고사"];
4295:   const index = orders.indexOf(row.exam);
4296:   if (index <= 0 || row.level === "" || row.level == null) return { text:"-", cls:"" };
4297:   const period = scorePeriodKey(row);
4298:   const previous = allRows.find(x => x.studentId === row.studentId && x.scoreType === row.scoreType && x.subject === row.subject && x.exam === orders[index - 1] && scorePeriodKey(x) === period);
4299:   if (!previous || previous.level === "" || previous.level == null) return { text:"-", cls:"" };
4300:   const diff = Number(previous.level) - Number(row.level);
4301:   if (!Number.isFinite(diff) || diff === 0) return { text:"유지", cls:"" };
4302:   return diff > 0 ? { text:`▲ ${Math.abs(diff)}등급`, cls:"good" } : { text:`▼ ${Math.abs(diff)}등급`, cls:"bad" };
4303: }

4270: function scorePeriodKey(row) {
4271:   const year = String(row?.schoolYear || today.getFullYear()).replace(/[^0-9]/g, "") || String(today.getFullYear());
4272:   let semester = String(row?.semester || "").match(/[12]/)?.[0] || "";

4276:   }

4288: function scoreExamOrder(exam) {
4289:   const order = ["1차고사","2차고사","학기말고사","3월모의고사","6월모의고사","9월모의고사","10월모의고사","11월모의고사","수능"];
4290:   const index = order.indexOf(exam);
4291:   return index < 0 ? 999 : index;
4292: }
4293: function scoreTrend(row, allRows) {
4294:   const orders = row.scoreType === "모의고사" ? ["3월모의고사","6월모의고사","9월모의고사","10월모의고사","11월모의고사"] : ["1차고사","2차고사","학기말고사"];
4295:   const index = orders.indexOf(row.exam);
4296:   if (index <= 0 || row.level === "" || row.level == null) return { text:"-", cls:"" };
4297:   const period = scorePeriodKey(row);
4298:   const previous = allRows.find(x => x.studentId === row.studentId && x.scoreType === row.scoreType && x.subject === row.subject && x.exam === orders[index - 1] && scorePeriodKey(x) === period);
4299:   if (!previous || previous.level === "" || previous.level == null) return { text:"-", cls:"" };
4300:   const diff = Number(previous.level) - Number(row.level);
4301:   if (!Number.isFinite(diff) || diff === 0) return { text:"유지", cls:"" };
4302:   return diff > 0 ? { text:`▲ ${Math.abs(diff)}등급`, cls:"good" } : { text:`▼ ${Math.abs(diff)}등급`, cls:"bad" };
4303: }
4304: function gradeToneClass(value) {
4305:   const grade = Number(value);
4306:   return Number.isFinite(grade) && grade >= 1 && grade <= 9 ? `grade-${grade}` : "grade-na";

5646: function enforceTeacherEnding(text){
5647:   const teacherEnding=/함\.?$|됨\.?$|임\.?$|보임\.?$|돋보임\.?$|기여함\.?$|발휘함\.?$|확장함\.?$|심화함\.?$|이해함\.?$|수행함\.?$|참여함\.?$/;
5648:   const convertSentence=sentence=>{
5649:     let s=String(sentence||"").replace(/…+$/,"").trim();if(!s)return "";
5650:     const replacements=[
5651:       [/하였습니다?\.?$/,"함."],[/했습니다?\.?$/,"함."],[/하였다\.?$/,"함."],[/했다\.?$/,"함."],
5652:       [/되었다\.?$/,"됨."],[/이었다\.?$/,"임."],[/알았다\.?$/,"이해함."],[/느꼈다\.?$/,"관심을 보임."],
5653:       [/생각했다\.?$/,"자신의 생각을 구체화함."],[/노력했다\.?$/,"꾸준히 노력하는 모습을 보임."],
5654:       [/참여하여\.?$/,"참여함."],[/활동하여\.?$/,"활동을 수행함."],[/관찰하여\.?$/,"관찰 내용을 정리함."]
5655:     ];
5656:     for(const [rx,repl] of replacements){if(rx.test(s)){s=s.replace(rx,repl);break;}}
5657:     if(!teacherEnding.test(s)){
5658:       s=s.replace(/[,.·\s]+$/,"");
5659:       if(/(?:캠페인|활동|실험|특강|프로그램|수련활동|방학식|종업식|입학식)$/.test(s))s+="에 성실히 참여함.";
5660:       else if(/(?:참여하여|수행하여|탐구하여|분석하여)$/.test(s))s=s.replace(/하여$/,"함.");
5661:       else s+="을 바탕으로 활동 내용을 정리함.";
5662:     }
5663:     return s;
5664:   };
5665:   return String(text||"").split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+|(?<=…)\s+/).map(convertSentence).filter(Boolean).join(" ");
5666: }
5667: function normalizedSentenceTokens(text){
5668:   return new Set(String(text||"").replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu," ").split(/\s+/).filter(x=>x.length>=2));
5669: }
5670: function jaccardSimilarity(a,b){
5671:   const A=normalizedSentenceTokens(a),B=normalizedSentenceTokens(b);
5672:   if(!A.size||!B.size)return 0;
5673:   let both=0;A.forEach(x=>{if(B.has(x))both++;});
5674:   return both/(A.size+B.size-both);
5675: }

5974: function recordRuleRowsBySource(source){
5975:   return (readonlyCache?.recordRuleRows||[]).filter(row=>String(row.__source||"")===source);
5976: }
5977: function recordRuleField(row,names){
5978:   for(const name of names){
5979:     const key=Object.keys(row||{}).find(k=>String(k).replace(/\s/g,"").includes(name));
5980:     const value=key?String(row[key]??"").trim():"";
5981:     if(value)return value;
5982:   }
5983:   return "";
5984: }
5985: function applySchoolRecordGuardrails(text){
5986:   let out=String(text||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
5987:   // 33_생기부작성절대규칙과 35_금지표현DB는 학교 검증 규칙이므로 완화하지 않고 최종 강제 적용한다.
5988:   recordRuleRowsBySource("35_금지표현DB").forEach(row=>{
5989:     const forbidden=recordRuleField(row,["금지표현","금지어"]);
5990:     if(!forbidden||forbidden.length>60)return;
5991:     const enabled=recordRuleField(row,["사용여부","활성화여부"]);
5992:     if(enabled&&/^N$/i.test(enabled))return;
5993:     if(!out.includes(forbidden))return;
5994:     const replacement=recordRuleField(row,["수정추천표현","추천표현","대체표현"]);
5995:     const auto=recordRuleField(row,["자동치환여부","자동치환"]);
5996:     if(replacement&&(!auto||/^Y$/i.test(auto)))out=out.split(forbidden).join(replacement);
5997:   });
5998:   return enforceTeacherEnding(out);
5999: }

6394: function programDurationHours(program){
6395:   const direct=Number(program?.hours||program?.durationHours||program?.totalHours);
6396:   if(Number.isFinite(direct)&&direct>0)return direct;
6397:   const sessionCount=Number(program?.sessionCount||program?.sessions||String(program?.sessionNo||"").match(/\d+/)?.[0]);
6398:   if(Number.isFinite(sessionCount)&&sessionCount>0)return sessionCount;

6400:   const match=time.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*[~〜-]\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
6401:   if(match){const start=Number(match[1])*60+Number(match[2]);const end=Number(match[3])*60+Number(match[4]);if(end>start)return Math.round((end-start)/6)/10;}
6402:   return program?.date?1:0;

7005: function downloadWordDraft(fileName, title, body) {
7006:   const html = `<!doctype html><html lang="ko"><meta charset="utf-8"><style>body{font-family:'Malgun Gothic',sans-serif;margin:45px;line-height:1.8}h1{text-align:center;font-size:22px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:25px 0}td{border:1px solid #777;padding:8px}pre{font:14px/1.8 'Malgun Gothic',sans-serif;white-space:pre-wrap}</style><h1>${escapeHtml(title)}</h1>${body}`;
7007:   const blob = new Blob(["\ufeff", html], { type: "application/msword;charset=utf-8" });
7008:   const link = document.createElement("a");
7009:   link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
7010:   link.download = `${fileName.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, "_")}.doc`;
7011:   link.click();
7012:   setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href), 1000);
7013: }

7352: function schoolPeriodStatus(now) {
7353:   const minute = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
7354:   const periods = [[520,570],[580,630],[640,690],[700,750],[820,870],[880,930],[940,990]];
7355:   const index = periods.findIndex(([start, end]) => minute >= start && minute <= end);
7356:   if (index >= 0) return { index, label: `현재 ${index + 1}교시` };
7357:   if (minute < periods[0][0]) return { index: -1, label: "일과 시작 전" };
7358:   if (minute > periods[6][1]) return { index: -1, label: "정규수업 종료" };
7359:   if (minute >= 750 && minute < 820) return { index: -1, label: "점심시간" };
7360:   return { index: -1, label: "쉬는 시간" };
7361: }

9288: async function selectGoogleCredential() {
9289:   if (!window.schoolBoard?.selectGoogleCredential)
9290:     return openOAuthGuide();
9291:   const result = await window.schoolBoard.selectGoogleCredential();
9292:   if (result?.canceled) return;
9293:   if (!result?.ok) { googleConnectionError = result?.reason || "Google 서비스 계정 인증을 연결하지 못했습니다."; updateTopSyncStatus(); return toast(googleConnectionError); }
9294:   googleConnectionError = "";
9295:   googleConnectionStatus = await window.schoolBoard.googleCredentialStatus();
9296:   const cached = await window.schoolBoard.readReadonlyCache();
9297:   if (cached?.ok) { readonlyCache=uep08123NormalizeReadonlyCache(cached.data); googleConnectionError = ""; }
9298:   else googleConnectionError = cached?.reason || "UEP 학교 데이터를 읽지 못했습니다.";
9299:   updateTopSyncStatus();
9300:   startReadonlyAutoRefresh();
9301:   toast(`${result.account || "Google 서비스 계정"}으로 UEP 구글시트에 연결했습니다.`);
9302:   render("settings");
9303: }

11477: function parseStudentLine(line) {
11478:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
11479:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
11480:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
11481:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
11482:     : trimmed.includes(",")
11483:       ? trimmed.split(/,+/)
11484:       : trimmed.split(/\s+/);
11485:   return { number: (parts.shift() || "").trim(), name: parts.join(" ").trim() };
11486: }

11477: function parseStudentLine(line) {
11478:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
11479:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
11480:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
11481:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
11482:     : trimmed.includes(",")
11483:       ? trimmed.split(/,+/)
11484:       : trimmed.split(/\s+/);
11485:   return { number: (parts.shift() || "").trim(), name: parts.join(" ").trim() };
11486: }

68: function detectHeaderRowIndex(rows) {
69:   const source = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
70:   const scanLimit = Math.min(source.length, 12);
71:   let bestIndex = -1;
72:   let bestScore = -Infinity;
73: 
74:   for (let index = 0; index < scanLimit; index += 1) {
75:     const cells = (source[index] || []).map(normalizeHeaderText);
76:     const nonEmpty = cells.filter(Boolean);
77:     if (nonEmpty.length < 2) continue;
78: 
79:     const uniqueCount = new Set(nonEmpty).size;
80:     const duplicatePenalty = nonEmpty.length - uniqueCount;
81:     const knownHeaderHits = nonEmpty.filter((value) =>
82:       /^(학생ID|학번|성명|사용성명|학년|반|번호|일자|운영일|일정ID|프로그램ID|강좌ID|기록ID|상태|구분|설정키|파일구분|스프레드시트ID|탭명|탭용도)$/.test(value),
83:     ).length;
84:     const titlePenalty = nonEmpty.length <= 2 && /UEP|표준|시트|DB|관리|기준/.test(nonEmpty.join(" ")) ? 8 : 0;
85:     const score = nonEmpty.length * 3 + uniqueCount + knownHeaderHits * 8 - duplicatePenalty * 2 - titlePenalty;
86: 
87:     if (score > bestScore) {
88:       bestScore = score;
89:       bestIndex = index;
90:     }
91:   }

240: function serialToDate(value) {
241:   const serial = Number(value);
242:   if (!Number.isFinite(serial) || serial < 20000 || serial > 80000) return "";
243:   const utc = new Date(Math.round((serial - 25569) * 86400 * 1000));
244:   return `${utc.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(utc.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(utc.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
245: }

247: function localDate(value) {
248:   if (value === "" || value == null) return "";
249:   if (value instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(value.getTime()))
250:     return `${value.getFullYear()}-${String(value.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(value.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
251:   const serialDate = serialToDate(value);
252:   if (serialDate) return serialDate;
253:   const text = String(value).trim();
254:   // __UEP_08159_SCHOOL_READ_DATE_CANONICAL__
255:   if(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/.test(text)){
256:     const instant=new Date(text);
257:     if(!Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())){
258:       const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(instant);
259:       const p=Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));
260:       if(p.year&&p.month&&p.day)return p.year+'-'+p.month+'-'+p.day;
261:     }
262:   }
263:   const match = text.match(/(\d{4})[.\-/년]\s*(\d{1,2})[.\-/월]\s*(\d{1,2})/);
264:   if (match) return `${match[1]}-${match[2].padStart(2, "0")}-${match[3].padStart(2, "0")}`;
265:   const parsedText = new Date(text);
266:   if (!Number.isNaN(parsedText.getTime()) && /GMT|UTC|^[A-Za-z]{3}/.test(text))
267:     return `${parsedText.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(parsedText.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(parsedText.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
268:   const compact=text.replace(/\D/g,'');
269:   if(/^20\d{6}$/.test(compact))return compact.slice(0,4)+'-'+compact.slice(4,6)+'-'+compact.slice(6,8);
270:   const monthDay=text.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})\s*(?:월|[.\-/])\s*(\d{1,2})(?:\s*일)?(?:\D|$)/);
271:   if(monthDay)return '2026-'+monthDay[1].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+monthDay[2].padStart(2,'0');
272:   return text;
273: }

275: function localTime(value) {
276:   if (value === "" || value == null) return "";
277:   if (value instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(value.getTime()))
278:     return `${String(value.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(value.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
279:   if (typeof value === "number") {
280:     const totalMinutes = Math.round((value % 1) * 24 * 60);
281:     return `${String(Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60) % 24).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(totalMinutes % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;

68: function detectHeaderRowIndex(rows) {
69:   const source = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
70:   const scanLimit = Math.min(source.length, 12);
71:   let bestIndex = -1;
72:   let bestScore = -Infinity;
73: 
74:   for (let index = 0; index < scanLimit; index += 1) {
75:     const cells = (source[index] || []).map(normalizeHeaderText);
76:     const nonEmpty = cells.filter(Boolean);
77:     if (nonEmpty.length < 2) continue;
78: 
79:     const uniqueCount = new Set(nonEmpty).size;
80:     const duplicatePenalty = nonEmpty.length - uniqueCount;
81:     const knownHeaderHits = nonEmpty.filter((value) =>
82:       /^(학생ID|학번|성명|사용성명|학년|반|번호|일자|운영일|일정ID|프로그램ID|강좌ID|기록ID|상태|구분|설정키|파일구분|스프레드시트ID|탭명|탭용도)$/.test(value),
83:     ).length;
84:     const titlePenalty = nonEmpty.length <= 2 && /UEP|표준|시트|DB|관리|기준/.test(nonEmpty.join(" ")) ? 8 : 0;
85:     const score = nonEmpty.length * 3 + uniqueCount + knownHeaderHits * 8 - duplicatePenalty * 2 - titlePenalty;
86: 
87:     if (score > bestScore) {
88:       bestScore = score;
89:       bestIndex = index;
90:     }
91:   }

410: function encodeGoogleUserOAuthRecovery(value){
411:   const salt=crypto.randomBytes(16),iv=crypto.randomBytes(12),key=googleUserOAuthRecoveryKey(salt);
412:   const cipher=crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm',key,iv);
413:   const encrypted=Buffer.concat([cipher.update(JSON.stringify(value),'utf8'),cipher.final()]);
414:   return {version:1,algorithm:'aes-256-gcm',salt:salt.toString('base64'),iv:iv.toString('base64'),tag:cipher.getAuthTag().toString('base64'),data:encrypted.toString('base64')};
415: }
416: function decodeGoogleUserOAuthRecovery(payload){
417:   if(!payload||payload.version!==1||payload.algorithm!=='aes-256-gcm')throw new Error('invalid OAuth recovery token');
418:   const salt=Buffer.from(payload.salt,'base64'),iv=Buffer.from(payload.iv,'base64'),tag=Buffer.from(payload.tag,'base64'),data=Buffer.from(payload.data,'base64');

605: async function getSheetsToken(credentials) {
606:   const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
607:   const header = base64url(JSON.stringify({ alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" }));
608:   const claims = base64url(JSON.stringify({
609:     iss: credentials.client_email,
610:     scope: "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets",
611:     aud: credentials.token_uri,
612:     iat: now,
613:     exp: now + 3600,
614:   }));
615:   const unsigned = `${header}.${claims}`;
616:   const signature = crypto.sign("RSA-SHA256", Buffer.from(unsigned), credentials.private_key).toString("base64url");
617:   const body = new URLSearchParams({
618:     grant_type: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer",
619:     assertion: `${unsigned}.${signature}`,
620:   });
621:   const response = await fetch(credentials.token_uri, {
622:     method: "POST",
623:     headers: { "content-type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
624:     body,
625:   });
626:   if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Google 인증 실패 (${response.status})`);
627:   const payload = await response.json();
628:   if (!payload.access_token) throw new Error("Google 인증 토큰을 받지 못했습니다.");
629:   return payload.access_token;
630: }

1309: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limit, worker) {
1310:   const queue = Array.from(items || []);
1311:   const results = new Array(queue.length);
1312:   let cursor = 0;
1313:   const runners = Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, Math.min(limit, queue.length || 1)) }, async () => {
1314:     while (true) {
1315:       const index = cursor++;
1316:       if (index >= queue.length) return;
1317:       results[index] = await worker(queue[index], index);
1318:     }
1319:   });
1320:   await Promise.all(runners);
1321:   return results;
1322: }
